thag3.10:1.3: What is yours is just for you.
thag3.10:2.1: For I’ve seen that faith is inconstant,
thag3.10:2.3: wavering. Even they who are passionate lose their passion.
thag3.10:2.4: Why should a sage waste away over that?
thag3.10:3.2: little by little, in this family and that.
thag3.10:3.4: I have the strength of my legs.
